topic: buildQueries callers when rowLimit becomes mandatory
lesson: RULING on S-0023-04bb, already in the recorded contract: backend/src/warehouse/drill-transactions.db.test.ts and backend/src/warehouse/all-plants-reconciliation.db.test.ts are in write_scope as the remaining concrete callers of buildQueries. Pass the limit explicitly at each call site. Do NOT keep a default value or add an overload to avoid editing them - that is the same compatibility shim the round-1 review deleted from ChatService and MisStatementService, and it would let a caller that forgets the limit silently get 100 rows. Both files are DB-gated and SKIPPED in the hermetic run, so a missed call site will not show up as a failing test, only as a typecheck failure in verify. Update call sites only; do not change what those tests assert.
